claim: Removing a person from /team sends their shifts that have not started yet back to the open pool (founder item 93, 2026-09-28, verbatim: "back to the open pool absolutely"; ADR 0215 item 26; OD-181). TeamService.deleteMember calls releaseShiftsOf after every refusal (owners manage owners, the last owner) and before the first membership write (the calendar-link stop for a person with an account; the roster delete for one without), so a refused removal opens nothing and a failed write removes nobody. "Not started" is read on the house's wall clock (pay-rules.ts houseWallClock / planLeavingShifts): a shift whose start minute is now or later opens whole; with no zone at all the clock is read at UTC+14, so only a shift unstarted in every zone opens. Each opened row becomes member_id null, state open, shift_type open, labor_cost null (written by release_leaving_shifts, the R9 function); a call-out (its cover is already open) and an already-open row stay as they are. A failed restaurants read or shifts read refuses with a 500 in words. The receipt carries shiftsOpened and the team_member_removed audit row carries changes.shifts_opened. Re-cut 2026-09-28 for the mid-shift split (R9): the in-progress shift that K2's first case used to keep whole is now cut. Behaviour: team-pay.spec.ts K2 (10 cases). The verify pins the anchors (10 of 10 anchor mutants fail it); the spec is the behaviour. Anchors re-cut 2026-09-28 for ADR 0215 item 27 (the releaseShiftsOf call now also passes the removal's hand-over; same behaviour without one).

A removal while a shift of the person's is in progress splits that shift at the removal minute on the house's clock (the founder on PR #502, 2026-09-28, verbatim: "handle it sota, it also has to take care of yhat exact edge case where it opens midahift then everything changes accordingly"; ADR 0215 item 26's 2026-09-28 bracket). The clock (pay-rules.ts removalClock): restaurants.timezone, else the country's only zone (houseFrame), else the remover's device zone sent as ?deviceZone= and checked by resolveSignUpTimezone, else none; with none, a shift that may have started is kept whole and named (receipt shiftsUnjudged, audit changes.shifts_unjudged), never cut. planLeavingShifts: start minute now or later opens whole, end minute now or earlier is kept, in between is SPLIT; the read reaches the day before the earliest possible today (leavingShiftsFrom) so an overnight shift is found; a rest cut after midnight is dated the next day. The worked part keeps the row with end_time = the cut and its break and labor_cost recomputed at the person's wage (read before any write; a failed read refuses); the rest is a new open shift with the same role and note, labor_cost null. Breaks: planned shift_breaks rows are split by where they fall (an overnight one placed after midnight; an unparseable start counts as after the cut); a recorded 0 stays 0; any other recorded number becomes null (Art. 68 minimum per part, assumed); a part too short to hold its minimum gets 0. All writes are one call to public.release_leaving_shifts (migration 20261201130000, SECURITY INVOKER), which re-checks each row against the read and each cut's consistency and raises otherwise, so none of it half-lands and the removal refuses. The audit row carries changes.shifts_split [{id, cut, rest_id, was_end, was_break_min}] and changes.shifts_clock; the receipt carries shiftsSplit and clock and no money. Behaviour: team-pay.spec.ts K3 (25 cases, all fail on the branch head c2bad0f0e), 22 of 22 service/pay-rules mutants killed; supabase/tests/20261201130000_a_removal_mid_shift_splits_the_shift_test.sql fails without the migration, passes with it, 12 of 12 SQL mutants killed (stand-in schema). The verify pins the anchors (24 of 24 anchor mutants fail it); the specs are the behaviour. Anchor re-cut 2026-09-28 for ADR 0215 item 27 (the release_leaving_shifts call is now the no-hand-over branch of one rpc expression, and the web sends deviceZone as one of several removal params).

"Replace with" on the /team remove dialog (founder 2026-09-28, verbatim: Replacement "'Replace with' picker"; Picker checks "refuse overlap warn rest but owner has a say to change it into warn all four to allow double booking"; ADR 0215 item 27). TeamService.deleteMember takes a hand-over (?replaceWith=&handOver=&accept=, parsed by team.controller.ts handoverOf, unknown codes a 400) and, before any write, re-plans the leaving person's shifts and runs pay-rules.ts handoverChecks on the chosen person: overlap (another of their shifts, not open or a call-out, overlapping on the wall clock, overnight wrapping, handed-over shifts against each other) REFUSED unless team_settings.allow_double_booking, then WARN; approved time off on the date WARN; a shift role their position/skills do not list WARN; their Monday-week worked hours over WEEKLY_REVIEW_HOURS (45) WARN. handoverBlock: any refuse, or any warn whose code is not in accept, is a 409 and nothing is written. The chosen person is read with .eq(restaurant_id) (another house's person is a 404) and may not be the leaving person (400); a shift id that is not an upcoming shift of theirs is a 400; a failed read of their shifts, leave or the setting refuses. Handed-over shifts are re-priced at the new person's wage and written with the opens and cuts in ONE call to hand_over_leaving_shifts (migration 20261202120000, SECURITY INVOKER), which calls release_leaving_shifts, moves the named rows, and itself refuses a person off this roster or an overlap not both allowed and accepted. GET members/:id/handover previews it with no money. The web picker (RosterSheet.tsx ReplaceWithPicker) only shows the checks; the FAQ says the procedure. Behaviour: team-pay.spec.ts K4 (24 cases, all fail on 8dd9bfeaf), 21 of 21 mutants killed; the SQL test fails without the migration, 6 of 6 SQL mutants killed (stand-in schema); TeamPayRound4.test.tsx 'Replace with' block (5, all fail on 8dd9bfeaf). The verify pins the anchors (25 of 25 anchor mutants fail it); the specs are the behaviour.

claim: Whether a "Replace with" hand-over may double-book someone is the owner's switch (founder 2026-09-28: "owner has a say to change it into warn all four to allow double booking"; ADR 0215 item 27): team_settings.allow_double_booking boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (migration 20261202120000), on team_settings because every /team house rule there is one typed column. pay-rules.ts doubleBookingRefusal refuses anyone but the owner either way, and updateSettings throws it before any write; the change is recorded in team_labour_settings_changed like the labour settings; getSettings returns false for a house that never set it (or a row saved before the column) and says mayChange.doubleBooking; TeamLaborSettings.tsx offers 'Allow double booking' only when it may. hand_over_leaving_shifts reads the column in its own transaction.
